title: Decide whether biome-textures gets a caller or is retired
body:
## Summary
pickBiomeTexture and BIOME_TEXTURES have no production caller; only their test imports them.

## Description
src/lib/visual-gen/biome-textures.ts:1 says it gives the autonomous texture path a themed default, but no file outside the module and its test imports it, so the PS-2 asphalt regression it names is not guarded anywhere. Fixed means either the texture path calls it or the module goes.

## Flow
- grep for biome-textures and pickBiomeTexture outside src/__tests__
- owner chooses: wire it into the texture path, or delete module and test

## Expected impact
The operator stops believing a guard exists that nothing runs. Deleting would break only its own test.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - a claimed guard is either real or gone
Before: 0 production importers
After: 1 importer, or 0 files
Method: probe - zero-consumer grep; wiring needs a product decision
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: direction
evidence: grep -rlw pickBiomeTexture src scripts (excluding __tests__): src/lib/visual-gen/biome-textures.ts only

title: Decide whether Lumen lighting presets reach a prompt
body:
## Summary
LIGHTING_PRESETS claims to be injected into prompts and has no production reader.

## Description
src/lib/visual-gen/lighting-presets.ts:35 documents notes as injected into prompts. LIGHTING_PRESETS, getLightingPreset and the three mode lists are imported by no production file; docs/research/lighting-pipeline-spec.md names them as a plan.

## Flow
- grep each export outside src/__tests__
- owner chooses: inject through the lighting prompt builder, or retire the module

## Expected impact
Generated lighting work either gets the presets or the comment stops claiming it. Nothing runtime can break.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - documented reach matches real reach
Before: 0 production readers of 6 exports
After: >=1 reader, or module removed
Method: probe - zero-consumer grep; the choice is a product decision
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: direction
evidence: grep -rlw LIGHTING_PRESETS src scripts (excluding __tests__): src/lib/visual-gen/lighting-presets.ts only

title: Style analyzer still misreads faceted as skin and non-metallic as metal
body:
## Summary
Start-of-word keyword matching leaves two misreads in the material analyzer.

## Description
src/lib/visual-gen/style-keywords.ts matchesStyleKeyword fixed mid-word hits, but "face" still matches "faceted" (chip mat-crystal, later skin rule overwrites surfaceType), and "metal" matches after the hyphen in "non-metallic", the phrase its own dielectric rule exists for.

## Flow
- POST /api/style-transfer with "faceted crystal" -> surfaceType skin
- POST with "non-metallic plastic" -> metal rule fires
- build a labelled description table, then choose whole-word keywords or a negation rule

## Expected impact
Material suggestions match the words typed. Whole-word keywords could lose a stem match such as glowing, so the table must cover stems.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - analyzer surface type matches the description
Before: 1 of 20 chips reads skin (4 of 20 before matchesStyleKeyword)
After: not taken
Method: simulation - two walked inputs; no labelled table exists yet
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
instrument: A labelled table of about 30 descriptions run through the route, scored for surfaceType before and after

title: Verify the biome fallback Poly Haven asset ids exist
body:
## Summary
Six hard-coded fallback ids in BIOME_TEXTURES have never been checked against Poly Haven, and the fallback downloadUrl is the JSON listing.

## Description
src/lib/visual-gen/biome-textures.ts:21-56 hard-codes fallbackAssetId values. The test checks only that each is non-empty. polyHavenFallback at :60 returns the files listing as downloadUrl, which asset-sources.ts documents as not the file to acquire.

## Flow
- GET api.polyhaven.com/files/<id> for each of 6 ids (free, but the night brief bans network)
- if the module survives its direction card, correct any 404 and resolve the listing to a file

## Expected impact
A fallback that resolves to nothing fails only after the search has already failed. Applies only if the module is kept.

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - the last-resort texture exists
Before: 0 of 6 ids verified
After: not taken
Method: simulation - network is out of bounds tonight
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
instrument: One free GET per id, recorded as a fixture-free script result

title: Style append truncates the user text past the prompt cap
body:
## Summary
With style on, applyStyleFragment cuts a prompt over 1500 characters; with style off the same prompt passes whole.

## Description
src/lib/visual-gen/style-dna.ts applyStyleFragment slices base + fragment to maxLength, so a base over the cap loses its tail and all style. The Leonardo route 400s first (src/app/api/leonardo/route.ts:41), so only GenerationPanel.tsx:84 on the 3D path reaches it. Returning the prompt untouched would remove the cap that path relies on, so neither answer is free.

## Flow
- paste 1600 characters into the 3D forge with style on -> 1500 sent, no style, no notice
- same with style off -> 1600 sent
- choose: refuse at the panel, or warn on the cut

## Expected impact
The operator learns their prompt was cut. A refusal changes what the panel accepts.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - a long prompt is never cut silently
Before: 1 path truncates silently
After: not taken
Method: simulation - one walked path; no provider limit measured for the 3D path
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
instrument: The real length limit of each 3D provider path, then a panel test for the chosen behaviour

title: Concurrent cold Poly Haven searches each download the catalog
body:
## Summary
The catalog cache has no in-flight entry, so searches during a cold fetch repeat the download.

## Description
src/lib/visual-gen/asset-sources.ts searchPolyHaven checks a finished-result cache only. Its comment says the cache exists so per-keystroke searches do not re-download, which does not hold during the first fetch.

## Flow
- fire 5 searchPolyHaven calls before the first resolves
- count fetches
- store the pending promise and clear it on rejection

## Expected impact
Fewer duplicate catalog downloads on first open. A shared rejection must not be cached.

## Evaluation
Claim: performance - one download per cold category
Before: not taken (expected 5 fetches for 5 calls)
After: not taken (expected 1)
Method: simulation - read from the code; client debounce not measured
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
evidence: src/lib/visual-gen/asset-sources.ts searchPolyHaven: cache read, then fetch, then cache write, with no pending map
instrument: A stubbed-fetch test counting calls for N concurrent searches

title: Remove the unused mode input from composeVisualPrompt
body:
## Summary
ComposePromptInput.mode is accepted and never read, and getChip has no production caller.

## Description
src/lib/visual-gen/prompt-chips.ts:96 destructures only subject and chipIds, yet GenerationPanel.tsx:75 passes mode, which reads as if the prompt varied by mode. getChip has test callers only. The panel is outside this context, so this needs a round that owns it.

## Flow
- drop mode from the input type and the panel call
- drop getChip or keep it as a test seam
- typecheck proves no other sender

## Expected impact
One less misleading argument. Nothing changes at runtime.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - inputs that do nothing are gone
Before: 1 unread field, 1 caller sending it
After: 0 unread fields
Method: probe - grep of composeVisualPrompt callers
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: Typecheck after removal, in a round owning the panel
